title: 费德提克·稻草花园
description: 费德提克变成圆润友好的稻草人姿态，给小花系布条，镰刀安放在远侧架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Fiddlesticks is a crooked scarecrow-like figure assembled from straw, dark timber, ragged red cloth, and a small cage-like torso frame. Preserve its long jointed limbs, tilted patched head, and recognizable asymmetry, but use friendly stitched-looking eyes and rounded crayon forms with no horror imagery. Its curved scythe rests securely on a garden tool rack, entirely inactive and separate.
art_direction.scene: The scarecrow stands beside a low flowerbed and gently ties a scrap of red cloth around a little sunflower stake. A small friendly crow perches on the fence nearby rather than swarming around the figure. Keep the pose relaxed and slightly clumsy, the garden bright, and the full long limbs comfortably inside the paper margins.
art_direction.palette: straw gold, faded red, warm brown, sage green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
